Hi, my name's Seth Purcell, and I sporadically write short essays and give talks on topics in the general vicinity of technology, management, leadership, ethics, and education. My motivation to write is usually just to challenge and clarify my own thinking, but sometimes I feel compelled to propound or refute a point of view.

Disclaimer: my thoughts and opinions are mine alone and do not represent my employer in any way.
